What is an advantage of manufacturing ethanol by fermentation rather than by the addition of steam
to ethene?
A
No gases that cause global warming are produced.
B
The ethanol that is produced is pure.
C
Fermentation is a fast process.
D
Fermentation uses renewable raw materials.

options.label: A
options.text: No gases that cause global warming are produced.

options.label: B
options.text: The ethanol that is produced is pure.
